purpose: Evaluate generalization to all remaining MInDS-14 language configurations
reason_for_extension: The completed 1116-example English-variety replication improved 1068/1116 to 1078/1116, but exact McNemar p=0.098737 remained uncertain
sampling: Every eligible unique 1–30 second recording; exclude all IDs, normalized text and source audio hashes in v1, v2 and the English external evaluation
models: Unchanged v1 fusion and v2 text/joint ensembles; v2 blend remains alpha=0.25
primary_comparison: Frozen selected v2 blend versus frozen v1 fusion, pooled across all nine configs
statistics: Language-stratified paired utterance bootstrap, exact two-sided McNemar, intent-cluster bootstrap sensitivity
multiplicity: Report raw p and Bonferroni-adjusted p=min(1, 2*p) for the two external primary comparisons; use adjusted p<0.05 for significance language. Bootstrap intervals are descriptive nominal 95% intervals.
stopping: Evaluate every listed configuration regardless of intermediate outcomes; no tuning, selective language reporting or further extension to chase significance
scope: Classifier-head transfer to languages absent from head training. Frozen encoders were multilingual pretrained; speaker independence and foundation pretraining overlap remain unknown.
previous_result: Keep the English-variety result separate and unchanged; a different-language result does not resolve English-specific uncertainty
